hook.name: LeveredHook
hook.description: A shared Uniswap v4 hook for Levered ETH/token pools that charges dynamic ETH fees composed of a base rate, volatility surcharge (decaying over a 15-minute half-life), quick-flip penalty for rapid sell-after-buy, and a fixed 1% creator fee. Fees are held as ERC-6909 claims and routed to per-pool treasuries. A defend mode redirects fees to buyback when the coin's price falls 20% below its peak.
